# .vscode

VS Code workspace configuration.

## Contents

- [`settings.json`](settings.json) - Workspace settings (formatting, linting, editor behavior)
- [`extensions.json`](extensions.json) - Recommended VS Code extensions

## Purpose

Provides consistent editor configuration across the development team. These settings are committed to version control to ensure all contributors use the same development environment.

## Recommended Extensions

See [`extensions.json`](extensions.json) for the list of recommended extensions. VS Code will prompt you to install them when opening this workspace.
